notes.title: V1.52
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Stats were not being saved from main menu. Only after playing.
    [*] Max level was missing a stat point
    [*] Achievements: Tackle achievements are now fixed. In fact, indirect tackle was broken. (Indirect Tackle: Hitting an enemy hit an enemy)
    [*] Achievements: Outsider achievement has been fixed
[/list]

notes.title: V1.50
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Music list can now be deleted
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Adding music dialog was non reactive to mouse clicks. Now it is.
    [*] Skills icons dissapeared, now they are back.
    [*] Menu music was been looped at full volume. Now it's not.
    [*] Won't crash when trying to play a deleted song.
    [*] Cursor coordinates where wrong when window was resized.
    [*] Moving the window was shrinking the viewport. Now it should not.
[/list]
